note: State attorney general consumer protection / consumer complaint pages for the 50 states and DC, one per state, built 2026-10-05. Each page was fetched (curl with a Safari user agent from this Mac; where blocked, Playwright on a remote browser machine, or for three Cloudflare/Akamai-walled domains a commercial fetching service with a US proxy, as recorded in via) and stored unedited in pages/ag/<USPS>.html; sha256 is of the stored file. quote and nameQuote are verbatim and are found in the stored page text under act.js norm. title is the page <title> with HTML entities decoded and whitespace collapsed. agHandlesConsumerComplaints is false where the AG page itself says consumer complaints go to another agency. Non-obvious or non-.gov domains carry ownershipEvidence: an official page that links to, redirects to, or names the page. No page here is claimed to handle HIPAA or health record complaints. contactKind is attorney_general, or state_consumer_office where the attorney general page says consumer complaints go to another state office (Hawaii, South Carolina, Utah, Wisconsin): those rows point to that office, and the attorney general page is kept in agPage.
